_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::fbi#3, and a FALSIFICATION of its advice. The entry told the reader to add a BINNING STRATEGY section and set BIN_SIZE_LOWER_BOUND. Done literally on upstream fbi_mortar_solidcoupling.4C.yaml that changes nothing: 4C selects the beam-fluid pre-sort in FBI::GeometryCouplerFactory from FLUID BEAM INTERACTION/PRESORT_STRATEGY (choices bruteforce/binning, default bruteforce), and the two couplers register different Teuchos timers. BINSIZE_BINNING_TIMER=0 with no 'ignored' notice; only PRESORT_STRATEGY: binning makes FBI::FBIBinningCoupler::Search appear (PRESORT_BINNING_TIMER=1). Following the entry produced an identical, clean, converged run — the silent no-op. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C (2026.2.0-dev, commit 89519cfe76).

_mutation.note: remove the pathology from the BINSIZE arm by giving it the REAL knob instead of the claimed one. BINSIZE_BINNING_TIMER becomes 1, which is a forbidden token, so the fixture must go red.

break the contrast the other way: leave PRESORT_STRATEGY at its bruteforce default in the PRESORT arm too. FBI::FBIBinningCoupler::Search never appears and PRESORT_BINNING_TIMER becomes 0, so the fixture must go red.
